title: Cumulative Moon recession since Apollo 11 (meters)

source.name: Lunar Laser Ranging -- Moon's measured recession rate
source.publisher: NASA (Goddard Space Flight Center / NASA Science)

notes: NASA's officially measured recession rate is 3.8 cm/year, tracked since Apollo 11 and 14 astronauts placed laser retroreflectors on the Moon in 1969-1971 (confirmed via lunar laser ranging, e.g. https://eclipse.gsfc.nasa.gov/SEhelp/ApolloLaser.html). The cumulative totals below are calculated by multiplying that official rate by elapsed years since 1969 -- illustrative arithmetic on a real, sourced constant, not an invented series.
